We isolate $x$ by applying the addition and multiplication principles, as usual:

$$
\eqalign{
	0 &\leq 3x+6 < 15 \[5pt]
	0 - 6 &\leq 3x + 6 -6 < 15-6 \[5pt]
	-6 &\leq 3x < 9 \[5pt]
	\dfrac{-6}{3} &\leq \dfrac{3x}{3} < \dfrac{9}{3} \[5pt]
	-2 &\leq x < 3
}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $-2 \leq x < 3.$
